_comment: Copy and edit paths/ports. Run: gossipper server -config /path/to/this/file.json. ui_data_dir enables admin console (/api/v2/*) and internal auth by default (settings.sqlite under ui_data_dir). Set auth.type to none to disable. When ui_data_dir is set, legacy /api/v1/* is auto-disabled. scenario_history_keep caps archived scenario XML versions per id (0 = unlimited).
